sections.title: Urgent Message from Abington Hospital
sections.text: Dear Maria, based on the information in your medical record, our research team has found that you meet the initial criteria for a clinical study that may offer you a new option worth exploring.

sections.title: About the Study
sections.text: This study looks at stomach conditions that can sometimes turn into stomach cancer over time — conditions like chronic gastritis or intestinal metaplasia. Doctors want to learn why these conditions happen and how they change.

sections.title: What Participation Involves
sections.text: If you take part, you may receive information about cancer screening and mailed screening materials. The study includes cervical cancer screening using an HPV self-sampling approach and colorectal cancer screening using a FIT test.

sections.title: Why You May Be a Match
sections.text: The available information suggests that you may be a potential match. Your information indicates that you live in a rural Pennsylvania community and are overdue for both cervical and colorectal cancer screening. A study team member must confirm your eligibility.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.text: If you are interested, a certified medical professional will answer your questions and confirm whether you are eligible. Receiving this message does not mean that you have cancer, and you do not have to participate.
